text: Expanded standalone Vector API probe passes exact adversarial parity on genuine JDK 21.0.11 and JDK 25.0.1 AArch64. JDK25 side-1024 candidates: extrema 2.59-2.60x, Int sum/product 3.04x/2.64x, Long sum 1.34x; Long product rejects at 0.14x with constant allocation. Clean JDK21 rows confirm Int sum/product 2.46x/2.67x and reject Long product at 0.13x. JDK21 extrema and Long sum need a quiet rerun: the follow-up ran while load rose ~55 to ~83 and is retained as quarantined evidence, not combined with the initial matrix.
